Implemented versioned schema migrations. What changed: new src/migrations.ts holds the schema as an append-only MIGRATIONS list (migration 1 = the existing baseline schema, moved verbatim) plus applyMigrations(), which records applied migrations in a schema_migrations table, runs each pending migration in its own transactionSync (rollback + retry-next-request on failure), hard-fails if a shipped migration was edited/renamed/reordered, and warn-continues if the DB is ahead of the code (rollback deploys). src/do.ts ensureInitialized is now 3 lines calling applyMigrations; the fragile SCHEMA.split(';') and the bolted-on try/catch index moved into the baseline migration (sql.exec handles multi-statement strings). CONTRIBUTING.md gained a 'Schema Migrations' section with the append-only contract and a worked example. Design pivot recorded in the bead: the original PRAGMA user_version plan is impossible - workerd rejects it with SQLITE_AUTH (verified with a probe test); saved as bd memory. Verified: test/migrations.test.ts adds 6 tests covering all acceptance criteria - fresh install lands on latest version with full schema + partial unique index; pre-framework DB (tables present, no schema_migrations) adopts the framework with data intact; version N->N+1 ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN preserves rows and the new column is usable; failed migration rolls back fully and retries; history mismatch throws; DB-ahead-of-code tolerated. npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm test all pass (17 files, 109 tests, was 103).

Fixed in three layers plus a structural refactor; all verified by typecheck, biome, and 124 passing tests incl. 6 new ones in test/expired-cart-payment.test.ts. (1) PREVENT: new src/lib/checkout-window.ts is the single source for checkout expiry; POST /carts/{id}/checkout now creates the Stripe session with expires_at equal (to the second) to the cart's expires_at, so a session can never outlive its cart — verified by a route test that captures the Stripe API call and compares it to the cart row. (2) GUARD: finalizeOrderFromCart (src/do.ts) now refuses with cart_released when the cart is not checked_out or has no items, and cart_not_found when the row is missing (it previously returned ok with an empty orderId) — verified by DO-level tests showing no order row and no inventory movement. (3) RECOVER: the Stripe webhook route (src/routes/webhooks.ts, refactored from one inline blob into named per-event handlers) treats cart_released/cart_not_found as an orphaned payment: auto-refund via stripe.refunds.create, durable row in the new payment_anomalies table (migration 003), and a new order.failed outbound webhook event; the event claim is kept so Stripe retries cannot double-refund — verified end-to-end with a signed webhook and mocked Stripe API (refund called with the right payment_intent, anomaly row recorded, claim kept, zero orders). Also: cleanupExpiredCarts Phase 2 gained a 10-minute grace period so a payment completed seconds before expiry finalizes normally instead of being refunded (tested), and its misleading comment was rewritten. Docs updated (README.md, docs/webhooks.md incl. order.failed payload). Follow-up filed: merchant-ykm (admin endpoint to list payment anomalies).
